description: This file contains implementation of modular inverse functions for big numbers (BIGNUM) in the BoringSSL cryptographic library, including algorithms for odd modulus, blinded inversion, and prime-based inversion.

methods.name: BN_mod_inverse_odd
methods.description: Implements the binary inversion algorithm for odd modulus, computing the modular inverse of a big number.

methods.name: BN_mod_inverse
methods.description: Computes the modular inverse of a big number, handling both odd and even moduli.

methods.name: BN_mod_inverse_blinded
methods.description: Performs a blinded modular inverse to protect against side-channel attacks.

methods.name: bn_mod_inverse_prime
methods.description: Calculates modular inverse using Fermat's little theorem for prime modulus.

methods.name: bn_mod_inverse_secret_prime
methods.description: Calculates modular inverse with constant-time exponentiation for secret prime modulus.
